description: This file defines an Android Activity class 'HeavyWeight' that loads a layout and sets an onClick listener to finish the activity when a button is clicked, demonstrating a 'heavy-weight' application lifetime management.

classes.name: HeavyWeight
classes.description: An Android Activity that sets a layout and a click listener to terminate itself.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and binds a click listener to a button.

methods.name: mStopListener
methods.description: OnClickListener that calls finish() to close the activity.
